claim: Onboarding OB-6, link half (founder /goal 2026-11-07, every fork the session's call; proposal p4-scratch/sw-walk/onboarding/proposal.md §3 OB-6, §4 F3). /verify-email runs handleVerify once by itself (ref-guarded) when a token is present and its person is signed in; signed out, or while the session is loading, nothing is posted and the button or sign-in gate stays. A verified pair finishes through AuthContext.signInWithSession (which stores it with storeSession, so activeRestaurantId follows the token's house, and resolves after /auth/me) and only then the router's navigate (no house -> /choose-house, menu_uploaded -> '/', else /get-started); there is no setTimeout and no window.location. A failed session read says the address is verified but the account could not be loaded, with 'Try again'. Behavioural proof: apps/web/src/pages/__tests__/VerifyEmail.link.test.tsx, which fails against origin/fix/onboarding-verify-mail-handoff's VerifyEmail.tsx.
verify: grep -qF 'autoVerified.current = true' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF 'if (autoVerified.current || !token || loading || !user) return' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF 'await signInWithSession(pair)' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF 'navigate(destination, { replace: true })' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF 'setSessionReadFailed(true)' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && ! grep -qF 'window.location.href =' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && ! grep -qF 'setTimeout(' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && test -f apps/web/src/pages/__tests__/VerifyEmail.link.test.tsx
